label.text: Hi ${firstName}, two-factor sign-in becomes required for Darpan on ${requiredDate}. Better to sort it before month-end does it for you.
Hi ${firstName}, Darpan now needs a second step when you sign in, and yours isn't set up yet. Better to sort it before month-end does it for you.
Two-factor sign-in means a code from an authenticator app, or a passkey, on top of your password. Set one up in User Settings, under Two-factor, at ${appUrl}. It takes about a minute.
From ${requiredDate}, Darpan will ask you to set it up when you sign in, so it can't catch you out.
Darpan will ask you to set it up the next time you sign in, so it can't catch you out.
You'll keep getting this reminder until a method is set up. Questions? Ask your Darpan administrator.
